Senior UI/UX Designer - Meridian Studio, Hyderabad

You will lead product design from user research through to a handed-off
component library, working directly with product managers and engineers.

Requirements:
- 5+ years in UI/UX Design and interaction design
- Expert in Figma, and comfortable in Adobe XD
- Strong grasp of Responsive Design and Accessibility, including WCAG
- Experience running usability studies and synthesising research
- Excellent Presentation Skills and Stakeholder Management
- A portfolio demonstrating shipped product work
